images.description: One entry per photo with a credential the creator chose to show. Sparse: a photo without one, or with the toggle off, has no entry. `index` and `blob` say which photo an entry is for.

subject.description: AT-URI of the post these credentials belong to.

main.description: Content Credentials (C2PA) read from a post's original photos at upload, for the photos the creator chose to show them on. The rkey matches the rkey of the associated post record, as with app.zeens.postMeta. This is a summary of what the C2PA manifest said, not the manifest itself: the manifest can carry an uncropped ingredient thumbnail and the photographer's GPS, so it is deliberately not republished. The summary is the creator's statement, signed by their repo; `status` records what the validator found, and a labeler may attest it independently.

action.description: The C2PA action identifier, e.g. c2pa.color_adjustments, c2pa.cropped, or a vendor's own such as com.adobe.*. Stored raw so a reader maps it to words at render time.

description.description: The producer's own description of the action, when it gave one. The only words a reader has for a vendor action it does not know.

softwareAgent.description: The software that performed this action, when it differs from the manifest's generator.

device.description: The capture device that signed, e.g. "Leica M11-P".

signer.description: Organisation on the capture manifest's signing certificate.

blob.description: CID of the blob as stored on the PDS. Binds the entry to one exact image, so a reordered or replaced photo cannot inherit another photo's credential. The stored blob is usually a re-encode of the original, which is what `embedded` reports.

index.description: Position of the photo in the post's embed.

signer.description: Organisation on the signing certificate, e.g. "Adobe Inc." or "Leica Camera AG".

status.description: What validation found. trusted: the signer chains to the official C2PA Trust List. legacy: the signer chains only to the frozen Interim Trust List. unrecognised: the manifest is intact but its signer is on neither list. A manifest that failed validation is never written.

actions.description: Actions from the active manifest, in the order recorded.

capture.description: Present when the photo's provenance reaches back to a camera that signed the capture, either because the active manifest is the camera's own or because an ingredient's is.

embedded.description: True when the stored blob is the original file, byte for byte, so anyone can re-verify its credential from the PDS: from the manifest inside it, or for a cloud manifest by following the file's pointer. False when the upload was re-encoded, which strips both.

signedAt.description: Time of the manifest's signature, from its trusted timestamp when it has one.

generator.description: The app or device that produced the active manifest, with its version, e.g. "Adobe Lightroom Classic 14.3".

ingredients.description: Source files the active manifest names, e.g. the raw file a Lightroom export was made from. Titles and whether each carries a credential of its own, never thumbnails: an ingredient's thumbnail is often the uncropped original.

digitalSourceType.description: IPTC digital source type of the asset, as a URI, e.g. http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/digitalsourcetype/digitalCapture or .../trainedAlgorithmicMedia. The strongest signal of generative AI involvement.

title.description: The ingredient's title as its manifest records it, usually a file name.

credential.description: True when the ingredient carries a Content Credential of its own.
